== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Dornoth]] system is a significant region of space within the [[Galactic Union]]. It contains several planets, including [[Dornoth I]], which serves as a secondary home for the [[Lichborn]], and [[Dornoth III]], a world characterized by volcanic activity that releases corrosive chemicals into orbit. The system's fourth planet, [[Dornoth IV]], is considered the most inhospitable inhabited world in the galaxy due to its sulfurous atmosphere and parasitic lifeforms. While [[Dornoth IV]] is the primary home of the [[Lichborn]], the system as a whole supports a massive population consisting of billions of [[inhabitants]] living on various space stations. The [[Lichborn]] culture is reflected in the local ship manufacturing, which utilizes skeletal designs and green light. The system is a site of strategic importance and has been the target of movements by the [[Grand Hive]]. It also contains an uninhabited moon near [[Dornoth III]] that houses an automated spaceport for small vessels. Additionally, the system has been identified as a potential feeding ground for the [[D’Niss]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|After setting a course for the [[Dornoth]] system, the vessel discovered a star-map displayed upon a [[holo-projector]] within the area. [[The Last Horizon]] eventually hovered at the system's edge, where it was later cast away, causing the ship to shudder back into real space minutes later. This system is visible through a [[portal]] in [[Shadow Ark]]'s sky and serves as a place where the relatives of [[Sola Kalter]] were once shunned. Ships manufactured in this region are characterized by engines that burn with [[green fire]] and a distinct skeletal motif. Ultimately, the [[Dornoth]] system remains a location to which [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] could return.}}
